prompts.atmosphere: Create a production sprite atlas for Skarth's frozen leviathan scene. Professional dark fantasy matte-painting brushwork, desaturated slate blue, navy and silver white, suggested detail and softly lost edges. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no opaque backing, no text, no grid lines, no labels, no borders. Exactly four isolated variants in a regular 2 by 2 grid, one sprite per quadrant, generous transparent padding around EVERY cell so no sprite touches a boundary. All sprites occupy only their own cell. One square atlas image. Top left: an irregular broad grey-blue storm cloud bank, softly diffuse edges, dark body. Top right: a different stretched wind-sheared cloud bank. Bottom left: a thin flat low icy water mist ribbon, blue-white wisps and translucent gaps. Bottom right: another low windblown surface mist with different silhouette and broken density. Clouds and mist are wide shallow horizontal shapes. Do not include scenery, ice, lightning or rain.
